title: Summarising a report
purpose: Turns what CI and scanners write into one JSON summary. JUnit XML (Maven Surefire, Jenkins and Azure DevOps shapes) and TRX become test totals plus each failure with its suite, name, file, line, message and the first lines of its stack. SARIF 2.1.0 becomes findings with rule, level, file and line. lcov and Cobertura become per-file line and branch percentages and the lowest-covered files.
inputs: A report file in the workspace, stdin, or `--text`. The format is detected from the content; `--format` names it instead, and `--lowest` sets how many of the lowest-covered files to list.
verifies: Each suite's declared `tests`, `failures`, `errors` and `skipped` are recounted from its cases, TRX's counters from its results, and every stated coverage rate from the hit counts. A disagreement is a `REPORT_TOTALS_MISMATCH` or `REPORT_COVERAGE_MISMATCH` warning naming both numbers.
limits: Anything it couldn't check is `UNVERIFIED`, and any element it didn't read is counted in `skipped`. XML and lcov stream in constant memory, up to the 64 MiB cap.
